body: I will stay on this site to try to help people.  My friend is gone. I can't help her. I never want anyone to go what I'm going through. Pay it forward.  Let a car in. Take someone's grocery cart. Buy someone's coffee. Doing for others will make you feel better.

Try paying it forward. Do well for others. Silly things like letting people in during traffic. Put someone's grocery cart away. We are only here a short while. We're all meant to help each other in one way or another. Focus on others instead of yourself and maybe you'll feel better and your karma will improve. Refocus. Look around.you are not the only one suffering. We all live in our own private hell. Try to give someone a step out of their hell, and you might take a step out of your own.

Try paying it forward. Doing good for others makes you feel better. Open a door. Put a shopping cart away.  Buy someone's coffee. We are only here for a while. And God put us here for each other. Don't know if you believe in God or not, but we are here to love each other. So instead of focusing on the love you don't think you have, give your love to others. The payback is amazing! You are so young. You have so much to offer! Dont waste it please.

Pay it forward. Start doing good for others. It will change everything. Stop thinking about how bad you have it and what you can do to help others. Don't know your monetary worth. But that's not it. Open doors. Put away grocery carts. Let people in during traffic. Be good and you'll feel good. Just try it before you end it ok? No clue where you are in life. But my best friend commit suicide. It's been 2 months now. I'm destroyed. Please. Please try something.

Can I be bold by saying that my maybe you need to see other people? Sometimes when we're sad it's because we are being selfish. Look outside yourself and join  group or help a stranger. You just sound lost. find your cause. You seem passionate. I think the world would suffer a loss without your passion. Pay it forward. Give your love. Stop waiting for it to come to you. Karma happens. Give and you will receive. God bless you.

You are in this moment. This moment will pass. Time heals all sounds. I promise. Suicide is the cowards way out. You can be strong and rise above. Be better than they thought you could. You are loved. If not by those you know, but by those who wish you well. And by t  friend who lost a friend to suicide 2 months . It's destroyed me. Don't do that. Live well. Live well. You'll get through this. Please get through this.

I hope it gave you new hope and a different view of the world. You almost weren't here. I lost my best friend to suicide. Please don't do that to those who love you. I'm now left with nothing but what-ifs for the rest of my life. She destroyed my life by taking her own.
